core.reuse: Exact recommend.__code__; isolated per-call globals replacing only fixed validation seam; original helpers unchanged
core.load: One fixed local file read at module initialization; SHA mismatch ImportError; no request-selected paths
core.public_calls: No I/O, process, plugin, model, network or control operations

provenance.Root_receipt_status: New proposed c29_root_association_v1 ABI; not supplied by current actual candidate
provenance.trust: Structural JSON correlation only; actual A Root must supply original owner-held associations. Labels, hashes and booleans do not authenticate evidence.
provenance.examples: All fabricated local diagnostic examples; actual-shape example is not an actual A capture

bounds.source_admissions: 1..32 original admissions from index0; no omissions or checkpoint/rebase. At contiguous100Hz ticks0..310ms only.
bounds.strings: 192 printable ASCII for identities; original raw request/capture line strings at most16384 bytes
bounds.qpc: strict uint63 integer nanoseconds in original clock_domain_id
bounds.counts: exactly four null or uint12; validity/quality cross-check
bounds.own_pose: position3 finite within +/-1000m; quaternion xyzw4 normalized within1e-12
bounds.goal: three finite coordinates within +/-1000m bound to Root config

envelope_fields.now_qpc_ns: strict uint63; no earlier than any retained capture receiver
envelope_fields.history: ordered earlier candidate objects; no fabricated/duplicate source capture
envelope_fields.root_receipt: null or exact proposed c29_root_association_v1 object

Root_receipt_fields.evidence_scope: must equal envelope, cannot be unassociated when complete
Root_receipt_fields.captures: null or ordered array corresponding to history+candidate: capture_sha256,source_record_sha256,request_raw,capture_raw,adc_pose,em_pose,em_origin_capture_sha256,cause_action_id
Root_receipt_fields.acquisition_pose_receipt: receipt_id,source_admission_index,acquisition_qpc_ns,pose; null when missing; faulted EM pose/origin must be null
Root_receipt_fields.action_registry: null or receipt_id,context,generation,as_of_qpc_ns,actions; as_of equals now; actions=[] means explicitly observed empty registry
Root_receipt_fields.occurred_action: receipt_id,action_id,state=executed,observation_capture_sha256,at_qpc_ns,from_pose,to_pose; original retained observed capture precedes execution

clock_semantics.original_model_ticks: Retained separately; C3 startup and contiguous-window validation never use absolute QPC milliseconds
clock_semantics.native: Root native admission plus actual ADC/EM source time equality and same original own pose; retained unique capture required
clock_semantics.output: Exact original integer QPC/full identities, never Fraction or private pseudo-ms fields

outcomes.disabled: STOP, core_ran=false, input_status=DISABLED; supplied fields still structurally checked
outcomes.missing_or_expired: STOP, core_ran=false, input_status=INPUT_UNAVAILABLE with specific missing/age reason
outcomes.complete: Actual frozen core invoked; core_ran=true and input_status=COMPLETE_DIAGNOSTIC even if its quality/pose/risk rules STOP
outcomes.authority: Always none; STOP is advice, never claimed behavioral stopping
